name: – Anna Strolenberg – § 50 – § 33
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 50. Emphasises that non-governmental organisations acting as a shuttle service in the Mediterranean create additional pull factors for people to risk their lives, and those of their children, to come to Europe for better economic opportunities, even if their chances of being granted asylum are extremely slim at best; reiterates that the rights of migrants have to be balanced with the rights of Europeans, specifically regarding their safety and security;
